name: Web document — Adam on AI burnout

content.body:
[highlight]I’m going through the craziest burnout I’ve experienced in my ~17 year career[/highlight]

I’ve been sick for 16 days now, haven’t even been able to go for walks

I kind of fucking hate AI

I think all of these things are related
